h: שַׁבָּת הַגָּדוֹל, מַאֲמָר ז׳ Shabbos HaGadol — Maamar Zayin

p: יוֹם ה' הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא.
"The great and awesome (ha'nora) day of Hashem."
נוֹרָא מִדָּתוֹ שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם,
"Awesome" is the attribute of our father Yaakov, peace be upon him,
שֶׁכֵּן אוֹמְרִים: הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא,
for thus we say: "the Great, the Mighty, and the Awesome God,"
נֶגֶד מִדּוֹת חֶסֶד גְּבוּרָה תִּפְאֶרֶת שֶׁהָאָבוֹת מֶרְכָּבָה לָהֶם,
corresponding to the attributes of Chessed, Gevurah, and Tiferes, for which the Patriarchs are chariots,
וְהַנּוֹרָא כְּנֶגֶד מִדַּת יַעֲקֹב.
and "the Awesome" corresponds to the attribute of Yaakov.
וּבַזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
And in the holy Zohar
(חֵלֶק ג' נ"ה:):
וַיִּפְגְּעוּ בוֹ
"And they encountered him (bo)"
וַיִּפְגַּע בְּמַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים מִיבְּעֵי לֵיהּ, מַאי "בוֹ"?
it should have said, "And he encountered the angels of God"; what is "in him (bo)"?
אִינְהוּ אָתוּ לְאִתְכַּלְּלָא בֵּיהּ כָּל רַחֲמֵי וְדִינָא.
They came to be included within him—all mercy and judgment.
וּבְתוֹסֶפְתָּא
And in the Tosefta
(ibid.)
אִיתָא: אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק הֲווֹ,
it is stated: "They were Avraham and Yitzchak,"
וְהַכֹּל אֶחָד שֶׁהֵם מֶרְכָּבָה לְמִדּוֹת גְּדוּלָּה גְּבוּרָה, חֶסֶד וְדִינָא.
and it is all one, for they are chariots for the attributes of Gedulah and Gevurah, mercy and judgment.
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁבְּצֵאת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם לְחָרָן אִיתָא בַּמִּדְרָשׁ
That is, when our father Yaakov, peace be upon him, departed for Charan, it is stated in the Midrash
(בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה ע"ה, ח')
(Bereishis Rabbah 75:8)
שֶׁרָאָה יִצְחָק שֶׁעֲתִידִין בָּנָיו לְהִגָּלוֹת, אָמַר לוֹ: בּוֹא וַאֲבָרֶכְךָ בְּרָכָה שֶׁל גָּלֻיּוֹת.
that Yitzchak foresaw that his descendants would be exiled, so he said to him: "Come and I will bless you with the blessing of the exiles."
וְכָל הַשְּׁבָטִים נוֹלְדוּ בְּחָרָן לְבַד מִבִּנְיָמִין, הַטַּעַם אִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
And all the tribes were born in Charan except for Binyamin, the reason for which is stated in the holy Zohar
(חֵלֶק א' קנ"ח.).
וְכֵן מַתַּן תּוֹרָה הָיָה בְּחוּץ לָאָרֶץ,
And likewise the Giving of the Torah took place outside the Land of Israel,
וְהִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה הָיָה בְּבָבֶל
and the dissemination of the Oral Torah took place in Babylon
(Sukkah 20a),
וְכֵן עִיקַּר הַיְשׁוּעָה לֶעָתִיד יִהְיֶה לְאַחֵינוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנְּפוּצִים בְּאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת אָרֶץ.
and likewise the primary salvation in the future will be for our brethren, the Children of Israel, scattered across the four corners of the earth.
וּכְשֶׁנִּכְנַס יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל,
And when our father Yaakov, peace be upon him, entered the Land of Israel,
הוּא הָרֶמֶז לְהַיְשׁוּעָה שֶׁתִּהְיֶה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים לִימוֹת הַמָּשִׁיחַ.
it is the allusion to the salvation that will come to the Children of Israel at the End of Days, in the Days of Mashiach.
וְאָז נִכְלְלוּ הָאָבוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹב: וַיִּפְגְּעוּ בוֹ לְאִתְכַּלְּלָא בֵּיהּ.
And then the Patriarchs were included within Yaakov—"And they encountered him, to be included within him."
וְזֶה שֶׁמַּזְכִּירִין בִּתְפִלַּת הַמִּנְחָה,
And this is why we mention in the Minchah prayer of Shabbos
שֶׁהִיא כְּנֶגֶד סְעוּדָה שְׁלִישִׁית שֶׁהוּא כְּנֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב
which corresponds to the Third Meal, which corresponds to the holiness of Yaakov
מַזְכִּירִין כָּל הָאָבוֹת: אַבְרָהָם יָגֵל, יִצְחָק יְרַנֵּן וְכוּלֵּי.
we mention all the Patriarchs: "Avraham shall rejoice, Yitzchak shall sing, etc."
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁבִּשְׁמִירַת שַׁבָּת אַחַת מִיָּד נִגְאָלִין
That is, through observing a single Shabbos, Israel are immediately redeemed
(שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה כ"ה, י"ב וְשׁוֹחֵר טוֹב תְּהִלִּים צ"ה וְתִיקּוּנֵי זֹהַר תִּיקּוּן כ"א וְזֹהַר חָדָשׁ יִתְרוֹ),
(Shemos Rabbah 25:12, Shocher Tov Tehillim 95, Tikkunei Zohar Tikkun 21, and Zohar Chadash Yisro),
אוֹ בִּשְׁמִירַת שְׁתֵּי שַׁבָּתוֹת כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּשַׁבָּת
or through observing two Shabbasos, as they said in Shabbos
וְאָמַרְנוּ שֶׁהַכֹּל אֶחָד:
and we have explained that both are one:
שֶׁיְּכוֹלִים לִזְכּוֹת בְּשַׁבָּת אַחַת לְשַׁבָּת תַּתָּאָה וְשַׁבָּת עִילָּאָה,
for one can merit on a single Shabbos both Lower Shabbos and Supernal Shabbos,
וְהַיְינוּ בִּסְעוּדָה שְׁלִישִׁית שֶׁכְּנֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב,
and this happens at the Third Meal, which corresponds to Yaakov,
וְנִכְלְלוּ בּוֹ כּוּלָּם:
in whom all of them are included:
ב' תְּרֵין דְּרוֹעִין, ת' תִּפְאֶרֶת, וְהַש' שָׁלֹשׁ רִאשׁוֹנוֹת כְּמוֹ שֶׁמּוּבָא בַּתִּיקּוּנִים
Beis is the two arms, Tav is Tiferes, and the Shin is the first three Sefiros, as brought in Tikkunei Zohar
(תִּיקּוּן י"ט),
(Tikkun 19),
וְאָז אִסְתַּלַּק יַעֲקֹב גּוֹ עָלְמָא דְּאָתֵי
and then "Yaakov ascends into the World to Come"
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק א' ר"ז.)
(Zohar, Vol. 1, 207a)
וְזוֹכִין לְשַׁבָּת עִילָּאָה וּמִיָּד נִגְאָלִין;
and they merit Supernal Shabbos and are immediately redeemed;
וְזֶה בִּתְפִלָּה זוֹ שֶׁכְּבָר עָבַר הַשַּׁבָּת בִּשְׁמִירָה.
and this is at this Minchah prayer, when the Shabbos has already passed in proper observance.
וְזֶה כְּנֶגֶד יוֹם הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא שֶׁהוּא מִדַּת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם בִּימֵי הַמָּשִׁיחַ,
And this corresponds to the Great and Awesome Day, which is the attribute of our father Yaakov, peace be upon him, in the Days of Mashiach,
שֶׁיִּכָּנְסוּ לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִפְגְּעוּ בּוֹ מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק לְאִתְכַּלְּלָא בֵּיהּ,
when they will enter the Land of Israel and the angels of God—Avraham and Yitzchak—will encounter him to be included within him,
וּמַזְכִּירִין כָּל הָאָבוֹת, וּמִי שֶׁזּוֹכֶה נִגְאָל מִיָּד;
and we mention all the Patriarchs, and whoever merits this is immediately redeemed;
שֶׁאַף שֶׁהָעוֹלָם נִידּוֹן אַחַר רוּבּוֹ וְצָרִיךְ שְׁתֵּי שַׁבָּתוֹת שֶׁיִּזְכּוּ לְשַׁבָּת עִילָּאָה,
for although the world as a whole is judged according to its majority and requires two Shabbasos to merit Supernal Shabbos,
אֲבָל מִי שֶׁזּוֹכֶה בְּשַׁבָּת אַחַת לְשַׁבָּת עִילָּאָה, הוּא בִּפְרָטוּת נִגְאָל מִיָּד
nevertheless, an individual who merits Supernal Shabbos in a single Shabbos is personally redeemed immediately
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁנִּתְבָּאֵר בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר וּבְכַמָּה מְקוֹמוֹת).
(as explained elsewhere and in numerous places).

Yaakov acted with wisdom: if all the tribes were completed here, the supernal order would rest on them; but they should not be completed in this land, only in the Holy Land... Therefore Binyamin was born only in the Holy Land."

For at first, when the Torah was forgotten from Israel, Ezra came up from Babylon and established it; it was forgotten again, and Hillel the Babylonian came up and established it; it was forgotten again, and Rabbi Chiya and his sons came up and established it." Rashi: Hillel had learned from Shemayah and Avtalyon (Pesachim 66a).

paragraphs.text: Parallel: Pri Tzaddik, Bamidbar 16 — “At Minchah of Shabbos we say ‘Avraham will rejoice, Yitzchak will exult,’ for Avraham's trait was kindness, love spreading in great joy. ‘Gilah’ is joy in the inwardness of the heart, not yet revealed; ‘Yitzchak yeranen,’ for from the aspect of fear comes revealed joy. ‘Yaakov and his sons will rest in it,’ for the holiness of Yaakov comes after both aspects, fear and joy, have been included in him, and then is the completeness of rest, to delight in Hashem. And this is the third meal, called ‘the will of wills,’ after love and fear have been acquired in us through the two previous meals.” Connection: Both explain the naming of all the Avos at Shabbos Minchah by the third meal, Yaakov's, in which they are included; Bamidbar 16 specifies what each brings and identifies Yaakov's inclusion as rest.

[Rashi does not comment on this line.]

paragraphs.text: Parallel: R. Shneur Zalman of Liadi, Likkutei Torah, Behar 2 — “‘You shall keep My Shabbosos and revere My Sanctuary’: ‘My Shabbosos’ are two Shabbosos, as the Sages said, ‘Were Israel to keep two Shabbosos properly, they would be redeemed immediately.’ These are two aspects of Shabbos present in every Shabbos, as it says, ‘the burnt-offering of each Shabbos on its Shabbos,’ and as the Zohar explains, that in every Shabbos there is a lower Shabbos and an upper Shabbos; of this it says, ‘You shall keep My Shabbosos.’ That is why the Yerushalmi says, ‘Were Israel to keep one Shabbos properly, the son of David would come at once,’ and this does not contradict the statement about two Shabbosos, for two Shabbosos also means one Shabbos.” Connection: Both reconcile one Shabbos and two Shabbosos by finding a lower and an upper Shabbos within one Shabbos; Likkutei Torah grounds this in the plural ‘My Shabbosos,’ while Rav Tzadok places the ascent to the upper Shabbos at the Third Meal of Yaakov.

paragraphs.text: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 19 (40b) — "Shin: Shabbos HaGadol is Binah, Shabbos HaKatan is Malchus. Beis: the two arms, Gedulah and Gevurah. Tav: Tiferes, through whom Shabbos is weighed against the whole Torah. The three crowns of the Shin are the three upper sefiros, and all are included in teshuvah."

paragraphs.text: Zohar I 207a (Vayigash) — "What is 'heavens'? The secret of the Patriarchs, and the secret of the Patriarchs is Yaakov, who includes them all, for Yaakov is the choicest of the Patriarchs... And because he ascended into the World to Come, one beautiful branch went out from him, from which all lights go out: Yosef the tzaddik, who gives sustenance to the whole world."
